releaseNotes: Fixed PDF to Word (.docx) producing raw binary %PDF-1.4 text on laptops with older Office (2007/2010), WPS Office, or missing Word PDF Reflow: enforces Microsoft Word IFDP PDF Reflow format, rejects/deletes corrupted raw-PDF output, cascades to LibreOffice Writer, and includes a built-in column-aware PDF-to-DOCX OpenXML extractor fallback so every laptop produces clean editable Word files.
